definitions.explanation: A sign displayed by stores and businesses indicating they are currently open and ready to serve customers.

examples.japanese: 「{営業中|えいぎょうちゅう}」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧{営業中|えいぎょうちゅう}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{営業中|えいぎょうちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: Convenience stores that are open even late at night are useful.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly displayed on signs at store entrances. Often appears with ⟦{準備中|じゅんびちゅう}→準備中：09540_junbichuu⟧ (preparing/closed) as the opposite side of a reversible sign.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {営業中|えいぎょうちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧: store that is open
- {二十四時間|にじゅうよじかん}{営業中|えいぎょうちゅう}: open 24 hours

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{準備中|じゅんびちゅう}→準備中：09540_junbichuu⟧: preparing, not yet open
- ⟦{定休日|ていきゅうび}→定休日：09541_teikyuubi⟧: regular day off
- ⟦{閉店|へいてん}→閉店：09698_heiten⟧: closing, closed
